name: taskhold
description: A task list you share with Codex: Codex picks up the next task, splits it into steps, reports progress and asks you when it is blocked, through the Taskhold remote MCP server. You watch a live board of every agent's progress.

interface.shortDescription: One task list for you and your coding agents, with live progress
interface.longDescription: Taskhold is a hosted task list you share with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and other agents. Codex files the work you ask for, plans it into steps, reports progress and, when it needs a decision, blocks the task with one question that you answer from the live board, including on your phone. Sign in once with OAuth, no key to paste. $12 a month or $120 a year after a 7-day trial.
